title: Finite affine cover of the relative matching target
statement: Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let K be an etale hypercover [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover]. Given a replacement stage A through n and boundary data Q for A [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage], there are an etale X-scheme N, maps b:N to Q.M and g:N to K_(n+1), such that b is surjective and N is a finite coproduct of qcqs etale X-schemes whose structure maps are locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For each retained simplex Delta and map theta:Delta to [n+1], b followed by its boundary projection and A.f equals g followed by K(theta).

source.place: 01GJ, relative matching construction; 094K, finite affine choices.

proof.text: Compose the boundary projections of Q with A.f. Naturality of each makes this a cone for K in degrees below n+1. The matching universal property of K gives a map t:Q.M to M_(n+1)(K).

Form the scheme pullback E of t and the matching map K_(n+1) to M_(n+1)(K). Its projection e to Q.M is surjective and etale, by stability under base change. The other projection g_E is over X. The pullback equation, the defining projection equations for t and the matching map of K give e followed by Q.pi and A.f equal to g_E followed by K(theta).

The affine opens of E give an etale cover of the compact space Q.M with open images. Select finitely many covering images directly with QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact. Their Spec schemes W_i are affine and etale over X, hence qcqs with the required properties of their structure maps. Take N to be their coproduct, with its induced map to E. The selected covering images prove surjectivity of N to Q.M, and the pullback equation proves compatibility of its two maps.

proof_origin.place: 01GJ, relative matching construction; 094K, finite affine choices.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_relative_boundary_cover
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : SimplicialObject X.Etale) (hK : IsEtaleHypercover K)
    {n : ℕ} (A : FiniteSplitReplacementStage K n) (Q : ReplacementBoundary A.U) :
    ∃ (N : X.Etale) (b : N ⟶ Q.M) (g : N ⟶ K.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk (n + 1)))),
      Surjective b.left ∧
      (∃ (k : ℕ) (V : Fin k → X.Etale) (ι : ∀ i, V i ⟶ N),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk N ι)) ∧
          ∀ i, CompactSpace (V i).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V i).left ∧
            LocallyOfFinitePresentation (V i).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (V i).hom ∧
              QuasiSeparated (V i).hom) ∧
      ∀ (Δ : SimplexCategory.Truncated n) (θ : Δ.obj ⟶ SimplexCategory.mk (n + 1)),
        b ≫ Q.π Δ θ ≫ A.f.app (op Δ) = g ≫ K.map θ.op
